question: What is your return policy?
answer: Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

question: How long do I have to return a product?
answer: Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
answer: Yes, cash on delivery is available for eligible orders.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI and cash on delivery for eligible orders.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3-5 business days.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can contact customer support through the support team at support@ecom.com

question: How can I track my order?
answer: You can track your order using the tracking link sent via SMS/Email or through the 'My Orders' section.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Currently, we only ship within India. International shipping is not available.

question: What are the shipping charges?
answer: Shipping is free for orders above ₹499. For orders below that, a nominal fee of ₹40 is charged.

question: My tracking link is not working, what should I do?
answer: Tracking links can take up to 24 hours to activate after shipment. If it still doesn't work, please contact support.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: Address changes are only possible if the order hasn't been shipped yet. Please contact support immediately.

question: What happens if I miss my delivery?
answer: Our delivery partner will attempt to deliver up to 3 times before returning the package to us.

question: Can I schedule a specific delivery time?
answer: We cannot promise a specific delivery time, but our courier will call you before attempting delivery.

question: How do I initiate a return?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the order you want to return, and click on the 'Return' button.

question: Is return shipping free?
answer: Yes, we offer free reverse pickup for all eligible returns.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item passes our quality check at the warehouse.

question: Where will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are credited to the original payment source. For Cash on Delivery orders, you can choose a bank transfer or wallet credit.

question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
answer: Yes, you can request a size or colour exchange from the 'My Orders' section if the stock is available.

question: What items are non-returnable?
answer: Innerwear, personal care items, cosmetics, and perishable goods cannot be returned due to hygiene reasons.

question: I received a damaged/incorrect item. What should I do?
answer: Please report the issue within 48 hours of delivery via the support team with photos of the damaged item.

question: Can I return a product without its original packaging?
answer: No, items must be returned in their original condition with tags and packaging intact.

question: How do I know my order is confirmed?
answer: You will receive an email and an SMS confirmation with your unique Order ID right after placing it.

question: Can I add items to an existing order?
answer: We cannot add items to an order once it is placed. You will need to place a separate order.

question: Why was my order cancelled by the system?
answer: Orders are occasionally cancelled due to unexpected stockouts or payment verification failures. A full refund is initiated immediately.

question: Where can I see my order history?
answer: You can view all past and current orders under the 'My Orders' section of your profile.

question: Can I cancel only a part of my multi-item order?
answer: Yes, you can cancel individual items from an order before they are packed or shipped.

question: Is it safe to use my credit/debit card on your app?
answer: Yes, we use secure, PCI-DSS compliant encryption gateways to ensure absolute safety for your transactions.

question: My payment failed but the money was deducted. What do I do?
answer: Don't worry. Failed transactions are usually reversed by your bank automatically within 3-5 business days.

question: Do you offer No Cost EMI options?
answer: Yes, No Cost EMI options are available on select credit cards for high-value electronic purchases.

question: How do I reset my account password?
answer: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your email/phone number, and follow the reset link or OTP.

question: Can I delete my account permanently?
answer: Yes, you can request account deletion through the Account Settings or by reaching out to customer support.

question: Do I need an account to place an order?
answer: You can checkout as a guest, but creating an account helps you track orders and manage returns easily.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: You can enter and apply coupon codes at the checkout screen before making a payment.

question: Can I use multiple coupons on a single order?
answer: Only one coupon code or promotional discount can be applied per order.

question: Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?
answer: Yes, members earn loyalty points on every purchase which can be redeemed for discounts on future orders.

question: Are the products on your website authentic?
answer: We guarantee that 100% of our products are authentic and sourced directly from authorized brand distributors.

question: How do I find the right size for clothing?
answer: Every clothing product page features a detailed 'Size Chart' link to help you pick the perfect fit.

question: What should I do if a product I want is out of stock?
answer: You can click the 'Notify Me' button on the product page to receive an alert as soon as it's restocked.
